# PasswordInput
Atlas Password input v1 — a password field with a show/hide toggle and an optional strength meter. Built on Input: 3 sizes (sm, md, lg), the Visibility of the value (hidden, shown) and the Input states (default, hover, focus-visible, disabled, error). The Strength boolean adds the Password strength meter (weak, fair, good, strong).

USE WHEN
· The user types a new password (sign up, reset, change) and should be able to check what they typed.
· The user signs in with a password and mistyping is likely on a phone.
DON'T USE WHEN
· The value is not a password (PIN, one-time code) → Input with the right inputmode.
· Several fields must stay masked for security reasons → plain Input type password with no toggle.
· The user is already signed in and only confirms a code → Input.
HOW TO USE
· Put it inside a Field so the label, help text and error come with it.
· The toggle is a Button named Show password or Hide password and reports its state with aria-pressed; the value shows as plain text while shown.
· Turn the strength meter on only when the user creates or changes a password, never on sign-in.
· The meter scores five checks: 12 or more characters, a lowercase letter, an uppercase letter, a number and a special character. Weak is 0 to 2 met, fair 3, good 4, strong 5. It is a hint; the server enforces the real policy.
· The level is written as a word (Weak, Fair, Good, Strong) next to the bars, so it never relies on colour.
· Do not block paste, and set autocomplete to current-password (sign in) or new-password (create).
· In Figma the eye is a 16 px icon laid over an icon-only Button, because a swapped icon inside a Button instance cannot be centred.
DO
· Tell the user the rules before they type, in help text.
· Keep the toggle reachable by keyboard right after the field.
DON'T
· Clear the field when the toggle is used.
· Show the strength meter on a sign-in form.
RELATED
· Input — the field underneath.
· Field — label, help text and error around it.
· Button — the toggle.

PROPERTIES
Size: sm | md | lg. Visibility: hidden | shown. State: default | hover | focus-visible | disabled | error. Strength: boolean (default off), with Level weak | fair | good | strong on the nested Password strength meter.
